Iran Sets Conditions for Strait of Hormuz Reopening Amid Regional Tensions

Iran's Revolutionary Guard stated that reopening the Strait of Hormuz is conditional on the U.S. accepting Iran's demands, not solely on Iran-Oman negotiations. These conditions include ending attacks, lifting sanctions, withdrawing foreign forces, and returning seized assets. This comes as the UAE described an Iranian attack on a tanker as a "flagrant violation" of a UN resolution. Meanwhile, the U.S. and Iran have reportedly revived their conflict, with U.S. bombers striking Iranian cities following Iranian attacks on U.S. bases. The coverage also touches on potential cyber warfare and Russian missile attacks in Ukraine.
